faqs.q: What does ODC mean in transport?
faqs.a: ODC means over-dimensional cargo—cargo whose dimensions require special vehicle, route or permission planning beyond a standard movement.

faqs.q: Which details are essential for an ODC quotation?
faqs.a: Verified length, width, height, weight, drawings or photographs, lifting method, route and site-access information are essential.

faqs.q: Are route surveys and permits always required?
faqs.a: Requirements depend on cargo dimensions, selected route and applicable rules. The need for surveys, permits or escorts is assessed case by case.
Construction machinery may be considered after its dimensions, weight, condition, loading method, route and destination access are reviewed.
